name: boom-big-nose-workflow
description: BBN multi-agent workflow for Codex and Claude Code: a plan checkpoint, one git worktree per feature with port/env/DB isolation, a lint/typecheck/test + reviewer gate before merge, dry-run merge and cleanup scripts, SDLC phases with exit criteria; Context7 and Perplexity MCP (both optional, with web search fallback).

interface.shortDescription: Plan, build in worktrees, gate, review and merge
interface.longDescription: Turns a goal into an accepted plan, isolated git worktrees per stream, a lint/typecheck/test gate plus a recorded review verdict, and a dry-run-first merge that never force-pushes. Each SDLC phase has an exit criterion before the next one starts.
defaultPrompt: Plan this goal with BBN and wait for my OK.
Run the BBN review gate on this branch.
Show the BBN merge order and predicted conflicts.
